props.text: Calendar demo — editable. Drag empty time to create (editor pops open), click an event to edit/delete it, drag to move, drag the bottom edge to resize. Every change (create/edit/delete/move/resize) persists via a single onChange script on the calendar.

config.script:
# One handler for every mutation: create / edit / delete / move / resize.
	ev = event.event
	action = event.action
	row = {"id": ev.id, "title": ev.title, "start": ev.start, "end": ev.end, "allDay": ev.allDay, "color": ev.color, "description": ev.description}
	events = []
	found = False
	for e in self.props.data.events:
		cur = dict(e)
		if cur.get("id") == ev.id:
			found = True
			if action == "delete":
				continue
			cur = row
		events.append(cur)
	if action != "delete" and not found:
		events.append(row)
	self.props.data.events = events
